message.content:
Looking at the circuit diagrams (panels A, E, F), the interneuron is labeled "IN" (the blue circle). Tracing the connections, the green neuron (vCA1, originating in the hippocampus) projects its axon onto this interneuron, while the black neuron (LA) projects onto the pyramidal neuron (PN). Therefore, the nerve that synapses on the interneuron is represented by green.

[ANSWER]C[/ANSWER]
